en: Fixed a stray `n` closing dialogs and a stray `y` confirming them; Enter and Esc accept and cancel (bind `y`/`n` to `confirm:yes`/`confirm:no` in `keybindings.json` to restore)
zh: 修复误按 `n` 会关闭对话框、误按 `y` 会确认对话框的问题；现在 Enter 和 Esc 分别用于接受和取消（可在 `keybindings.json` 中将 `y`/`n` 绑定到 `confirm:yes`/`confirm:no` 以恢复原行为）
